newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks seen mixed ahead of Q2 GDP numbers.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks seen mixed ahead of Q2 GDP numbers.

text.p: U.S. stocks were expected to open mixed after Thursday's mini-rollercoaster ride, with Wall Street getting final second quarter Gross Domestic Product figures ahead of the market opening.
Money managers eager to dress up their portfolios ahead of the end of the third quarter were also expected add to Friday's market action.
"Unless there's a real surprise in the GDP numbers, I don't expect us to head south," said Peter Cardillo of Westfalia Investments.
Final second quarter GDP is due at 0830 EDT/1230 GMT. Economists expect a 4.6 percent rise compared to a 4.8 percent increase in the first quarter.
"It won't make too much of a difference since it's a final revision, but if it comes in over expectations, it could be a negative on bonds and might cause early selling," he said.
"Most of the concentration today will be on window dressing," he said.
The long bond ws up 6/32 to yield 6.87 percent. Standard & Poor's December futures were off 1.05 to 690.90.
